462:t_004:50.en:
$$赤木$$
「The golden tag team of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ and $$２１世紀警備保障$$ is born!」

462:t_004:51.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「I like it! A pair of gold-loving misers!」

462:t_004:52.en:
$$メール$$
「If $$クロウ$$ were here, they'd be a trio.」

462:t_004:53.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm relieved that guy isn't in our force.」

462:t_004:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「A-Anyway...! Company finances matter, but we have to protect Earth's peace!」

462:t_004:55.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$タケル$$ is right. Let's do our best, President $$ワッ太$$.」

462:t_004:56.en:
$n
「$$ワッ太$$, $$赤木$$! If you want to pay off your debt, beat the enemies yourselves!」

462:t_004:57.en:
$$赤木$$
「Wait, $n! It's not a debt yet!」

462:t_004:58.en:
$$勝平$$
「Who cares?! Hurry up! The enemy's waiting for us!」

462:t_004:60.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right! Protect the city and wipe out the deficit! We'll do both!!」

462:t_005:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「Be careful! The dimensional boundary is distorting!」

462:t_005:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Could it be $$宇宙怪獣$$?! Or $$インベーダー#pilot$$s?!」

462:t_005:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「I don't care which! If they come, we'll just beat the crap out of them!」

462:t_006:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$バンドック$$...! It's $$ガイゾック$$'s $$バンドック$$!」

462:t_006:3.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Impossible! We destroyed it in the $$多元戦争$$!」

462:t_006:4.en:
$$恵子$$
「There are robots from the army around $$バンドック$$ too!」

462:t_006:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So that clay-doll machine is their boss?!」

462:t_006:6.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「$$ガバールニウム$$ confirmed. That should have been placed under my control when I conquered $$ガバール星$$.」

462:t_006:7.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I cannot permit anything outside my control to exist. I shall destroy it immediately.」

462:t_007:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That bastard! He's targeting $$トライダー$$ just when we got it upgraded?!」

462:t_007:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「That isn't the $$ガイゾック$$ we defeated in the $$多元戦争$$...!」

462:t_007:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's the one that took over $$シグマ$$ on Uncle $$梅本$$'s home, $$ガバール星$$!」

462:t_007:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll talk later, $$ワッ太$$! That thing... is humanity's enemy!」

462:t_007:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hey, you! What did you come to Earth for?!」

462:t_007:8.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I am $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ No. 21... My mission is to remove humans with evil thoughts from the universe.」

462:t_007:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$コンピュータードール#pilot$$...! So you're just a machine?!」

462:t_007:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「Is this thing going to force its own twisted logic on humans, just like $$ストライカー#pilot$$ in the $$霧の海$$?!」

462:t_007:11.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Admit that you yourselves are evil.」

462:t_007:13.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「You hate, deceive, and kill one another... Such creatures destroy the quiet peace of the universe.」

462:t_007:14.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I was built to clean away such creatures.」

462:t_007:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's not true...! Everyone's a good person!」

462:t_008:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$ガイゾック$$! Now I can say for sure that everything you're saying is bullshit!」

462:t_008:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sure, there are bad people! But the universe isn't full of nothing but them!」

462:t_008:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「If it were, Uncle $$梅本$$ could never have found happiness on Earth after escaping from $$ガバール星$$ under your control!」

462:t_008:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Everyone! Don't let this thing fool you!」

462:t_008:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's only looking at the bad in humans and spouting whatever it wants!」

462:t_008:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「But I have no intention of becoming the kind of person it describes!」

462:t_008:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Even if no one thanks me, even if I get hurt, I'll protect the people I care about... I'll protect Earth!!」

462:t_008:9.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「I feel the same way, $$勝平$$!」

462:t_008:10.en:
$$恵子$$
「That's why we pilot $$ザンボット$$!」

462:t_008:11.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Heh... That's one hell of a speech!」

462:t_008:12.en:
$$万丈$$
「Everyone! We can't let $$勝平$$ outdo us!」

462:t_008:13.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Roger! $$ザンボット$$'s moonlight will light the way!」

462:t_008:16.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Correction judged impossible... Then I shall eliminate you.」

462:t_008:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「Try it if you think you can, bastard! I'll teach you how strong... how wonderful humans are!」

462:t_009:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「My system has been destroyed... I wish to ask one final question...」

462:t_009:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「To protect what matters to us!」

462:t_009:4.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「I... cannot comprehend... Humans... abandon... civilization...」

462:t_009:5.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「Otherwise... what awaits... beyond it... is... despair.........」

462:t_010:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「But now the master computer controlling the robot army has been defeated.」

462:t_010:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Will they stop coming to Earth now?」

462:t_010:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ we fought in the $$多元戦争$$ was No. 8... Today's was No. 21.」

462:t_010:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「So there are more of those bastards somewhere out there.」

462:t_010:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「They might come to Earth again and call humanity an evil species.」

462:t_010:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then I'll fight them...! Even if no one thanks me, even if I get hurt!」

462:t_010:10.en:
$n
「You're not alone, $$勝平$$. Don't forget about us.」

462:t_010:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's what you mean by how wonderful humans are, isn't it?」

462:t_010:13.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Thanks to $$２１世紀警備保障$$'s evacuation guidance, there were almost no civilian casualties.」

462:t_010:14.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return to base. There is no reason to linger now that the battle is over.」

462:t_012:0.en:
$$木下$$
「Team 'Salarymen' has earned over 25,000 in funds!」
